newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Centris active on speculative interest.
newsitem.headline: Centris active on speculative interest.

text.p: Shares of transportation firm PT Centris Multi Persada Pratama soared on Wednesday on speculative interest, brokers said.
Brokers said interest in the stock remained high following speculation of possible acquisitions, coupled with talk that the firm had secured a loan to expand its taxi service.
But a company official denied the speculation. "We don't have any plans to acquire any company. I have so far not heard that our company is a target of acquisition," he said.
He said Centris had no plans or was taking any action that were not already public knowledge.
Speculation that Centris had secured a loan to expand its taxi service was also incorrect, he said.
By lunchtime, Centris rose 33.73 percent, or 700 rupiah, to 2,775 rupiah on a volume of 7.6 million shares.
The official said the company's expansion plans called for the addition of 1,400 taxis in 1996 and 1997.
He said that by January 6, 1,000 of the 1,400 units had become operational. The remainder was scheduled to hit the streets by March this year.
The official said he did not have data at hand on the total number of taxis the company owned.
Aside from speculative interest, sentiment on the stock improved on expectations of higher revenue in 1997, brokers said.
"The overall market sentiment is firm. Many investors are snapping up cheap stocks like Centris and other secondaries," a local broker said.
